config.reference: OpenMP thread count comparison: 4 vs 8, cumulative source 001+002 unchanged
config.hypothesis: With identical cumulative FAST-LIVO2 source, runtime parameters, outdoor input and evaluation, MP_PROC_NUM=8 will reduce high-load full_cycle p95 relative to MP_PROC_NUM=4 by up to the targeted 5.5 ms without regression gates failing.

regression_gates.successful_source_scan_sets: identical after source warmup5s; duplicate keys forbidden
regression_gates.inputs: all recorded lidar/imu callbacks present; full_cycle count >= lidar messages-1; publish/diagnostic/successful cycle counts equal
regression_gates.state_age_validity: Audit nonfinite/negative raw ages and /clock EOF; use existing steady-mapped age for tail, not frozen clock freshness
regression_gates.performance_claim: mean <=80ms is average only; p95 <=80ms is 95-percent budget; baseline reproduction reported separately
